reason: The frozen v1 reference wrapper uses optional psutil for both memory fields and has no dependency-free fallback. psutil is absent in the pinned interpreter. Both fields are unmeasured, rather than zero or a qualified memory bound.

independent_probe.basis: A separate post-run Python process; this is a helper-availability check only and cannot measure or reconstruct producer memory.

preservation: No production artifact or frozen v1 builder was changed and no reference build repeated. Producer memory cannot be recovered after process closure.
future_requirement: The experiment runner must qualify dependency-free Windows RSS/peak collection before READY, record its own readings and fail its memory-resource gate if readings are unavailable. Audit memory remains separate from producer memory.
